comment: HQ edits this file to change over-entry limits. A report is flagged when kapitlach is above max(kapitlachMultiple × the child's own quota this month, the grade's ladderTopKapitlach) OR minutes is above that grade's minutes cap. ladderTopKapitlach is the highest kapitlach any ladder asks of that grade, in any month. minutes is twice that grade's highest minute quota. Flagged reports do not count in public totals, ranks, Perfect Platoon, or medals until a base commander or HQ accepts them (flaggedCountsBeforeReview is false). Removed reports are void. The old above-quota confirm still covers a high-but-inside-the-line report.
